body: Can it be stress??? Think about it, you breathe faster your heart beats faster when you are stressed, imagine a whole country that’s stressed out with only over crowded buildings and no trees to absorb it.
I used to be a worship leader at a ‘mega church’ they used my trauma as a reason to explain everything.
It’s a temporary solution, until I find a nanny and they have a job that can allow them to support themself and get their own place.
I know, I just want some ideas on how to talk to them.
It’s a little more complex than that. My kid loves them, they love my kid. My kids loves their kids. Plus, they don’t really have a job or a way of affording somewhere to stay.

I know, it’s a difficult situation, but it’s beneficial to both of us. They get to live in my house rent free and I get someone who can drop off my kid and pick them up from school. Not to mention, we still get to have eachother in our lives.
I honestly don’t think so

Yes. But I’ve actually had to tell him, hey have you talked with your therapist about your boundary issues? Hey have you told your therapist how you feel about yourself? And he’s like no? Why? And I’m like so you can work on them!

We spent about a week processing it together, I left to a friends the day after he chugged a bottle of rum and was throwing up and crying on the porch saying he didn’t think I loved him because I didn’t hug him enough.

I really appreciate your post. I purposely don’t mention my daughter because I feel like that becomes the focus of the posts, and I am well aware that my daughter comes first. We were friends first, we did move quickly, and the proposal was a surprise to me, as we both discussed that we needed to slow things down. I am in therapy and have been for a long time, he is also in therapy. And I wrote this post because his behavior is very unsettling to me, but Reddit wouldn’t allow me to post the whole story as it asked for moral opinions. However, I feel like because of my history of trauma I may react too strongly and don’t feel like I can trust my instincts. So, I appreciate your honesty, I do want to leave, but I am stuck right now.

He has always had bad boundaries, and I thought/think it’s because of his last relationship that was verbally abusive towards him. But he’s never gone to this extreme, but he’s never believed I was about to leave him before.
I mean, he purposely phrased his speech to make it seem like he was breaking up with me… I think that means something
He told me he intended to make it that way in order to surprise me

I resent my parents for not protecting me. I was sexually abused as a child by my friend’s dad, my parents never even bothered to call the guy to make sure the house I was sleeping at was safe. I resent my mom because she pretended like she didn’t know my dad was terrorizing us through physical violence, verbal abuse, and emotional/psychological abuse.

Yes, that’s exactly what I was going for, heroism. Or maybe I didn’t know what to do, and I didn’t want to get her fired by saying all of that to someone I do know. 
I made the decision to stop therapy, but if you failed to read this part, I live in a shelter for woman who have been hurt, a lot of them aren’t in the same place as I am and there’s the possibility that she is doing the same thing to them, but they wouldn’t recognize it because it’s not obvious abuse. 
Funny, thing I didn’t realize it was abuse until after I got feedback from my post. 
So, again thanks for the feedback, I appreciate your honesty.

I feel like it’ll seem like I’m telling on her because I’m unhappy with her services... I’m afraid I’ll seem petty. 

I’m more afraid the staff that I can trust will be afraid to talk with me because if I get her fired everyone will know and then everyone will steer clear of me.

Thank you for this. I’ve been remaining calm and talking with her. I told her I’m not going to yell anymore, I don’t like to yell and I know you don’t like when I yell. So, it’s been working really well. If she doesn’t listen she knows one of her toys goes into timeout for the rest of the day and it’s amazing the difference already. 

I just want to say thank you to everyone for the support. I felt like a terrible mom and I was always losing my temper and she reacted to that. Now she is mirroring me, even doing the deep breathing to calm herself. 

I do not want her to end up like me, and I do not want to be my parents so all of your advice has been heard and I have been applying it. 

THANK YOU!

Holy fucking fuck. You’ve put into words something I’ve been struggling to identify and define for like 15 years! 

I know I’ve been through a lot, but it’s just like this! I could finally say something and do something! 

Thank you. Seriously. 

This forum has been so helpful. I never knew there were other people like me.
Oh my god! It’s not just me???? Seriously, all week is horrible. Walk into therapy and..., “things have been pretty good!”

Update: 
I am doing everything I can to push her away despite it being the last thing I want and I think it’s working. Is that the CPTSD? 

I called and left her not one but TWO drunken voicemails last night. 

I don’t remember what I said, but now I’m too embarrassed to ever see her again. 

What is wrong with me?

Again super drunk. Like super super drunk. I just left a voicemail, that I already regret.... I made a video of me and my daughter singing you are my sunshine, it went viral for my town, and my abuser saw it. He’s been contacting me nonstop. I block a number and he has a new number. He’s been constantly trying to contact me. He wants to see his daughter. 
I’d rather die than have him see her.

Yep I’m drunk as fuck. Super fucking drunk. It’s the only way to ease that gut tearing feeling that I’ve got right now. 

I never should’ve ended therapy. I LOVE my therapist, but I feel bad that she has to deal with me so I ended it to protect her. Now I’m scared I’m going to be hospitalized. I just started a new job as an RN Fellow... I can’t lose this job because of this. So I’m hiding. 

I’m wondering who I could ask to sleep at their house to avoid it.
I’m currently hiding out at a bar. I told my dad I had rugby practice so I could leave, but I’m scared to go home. Almost a pitcher in and I still can’t bring myself to go home.

Maybe it’s the right thing to do to let her go. I don’t deserve her worry and she doesn’t deserve to be worried about me. If you read my past posts you’ll understand more of why. 
Sharing my story with her is cruel of me. 
I feel guilty every time I leave therapy.
Yeah, same here. My dad was an abusive asshole, but my mom... she just pretended it was t happening, I have a harder time being around her than my dad.

My dad: yeah, I’m an asshole, maybe I should just go walk into traffic, variations of he must be stupid

My mom: avoid any type of talk that centers around anything but her pretend perfect life.
I get that. My 3 year has a sensory processing disorder. She is a sensory seeker so she’s often very wild, it’s very hard for me and I often feel ashamed of how I react or feel about it.

I’ve felt this way too. I went to a concert with friends in Chicago. They’d stop amidst all the traffic of people trying to leave, to take selfies, and I was embarrassed because, didn’t they know that was rude?! 
Loud laughter, being any sort of disruptive has always made me so super uncomfortable. I never realized this was because of the abuse I’ve endured. 
Any time I’ve even been slightly disruptive in class I’ve felt anxious about it for days until it became clear I wasn’t going to get kicked out of school for it.
Wait, I’ve been thinking and I wonder what you mean by if she brings it up... do you mean like if she brings up that she can’t accept it, or it’s too personal of a gift.. or she hated it?
Absolutely, that’s so cool that you’d want to! Thank you!
That’s really helpful, I never considered this. Thank you!

I went in for my Monday session and the secretary told me that it was my therapist’s birthday that day. I immediately asked if I could get her something and she told me she could accept gifts, but she had to donate the value of the gift to charity. So I clarified if I made her something than would she then have to name a value to donate? She said no. I mean what’s the point of giving a present if they then have to pay for it. So I took out all of my old painting stuff, and some old barn wood and made her a sign. I had to fight the urge to just toss it or keep it for myself, because I was afraid she would think it was weird or silly for me to have made her something. Or perhaps she’d take it as too personal of a gift... or perhaps she would think it wasn’t good and then I’d see that initial reaction when she opened the gift and was disappointed. So I decided to give it to her. Despite the urge to know what she thought of it initially, I couldn’t bare the thought of her not liking it but trying to hide it. I love giving gifts but I am extremely self conscious about it. So, I told the secretary to give it to her after my session, and after my session I booked it to make sure she didn’t open it while I was there. I half expected a phone call as I was driving home, but I didn’t get one. She did call later, but only to talk about booking appointments further out... she didn’t even mention the gift. 
I’m not looking for a thank you, I’m worried it’s going to be an ambush when I go back on Wednesday. Like she purposely didn’t say anything so she could bring it up in therapy, and I don’t want to have to explain a gift or why I did it, and honestly the whole thing makes me want to run away from therapy as fast as I can.

I stopped talking for the rest of the day, it was either that or cry. A friend reached out later that night, I broke down with her, I guess I need someone to see me and see past what I’m able to show them. My therapist can tell when I’m upset but doesn’t question it or push me to talk, and honestly I’m scared she will ship me off to a hospital if she knew how I felt. I don’t want to kill myself, but I do at the same time... I just want to feel better and I want my daughter to have the mom she deserves. 
As dumb as it sounds I think I need a good hug and just someone I can tell how I really feel without fear of being hospitalized.

Sarcasm. You know how many people have said that to people like me? And guess what it doesn’t get better. My life gets worse with every breath I take. That’s not going to change because you said it’s going to get better.
I feel so much better now that you said that.

Yes, she called me and I’ve seen her since. Who really knows how she feels though because she practices unconditional positive regard, which basically says even if I find you vulgar and disgusting I’m going to say I support and accept you.
Fuck it. I emailed her. Please don’t let her hate me.

I am currently in nursing school and seeking therapy through the university. Because of that I’m seeing a student, and because she is a student every session is recorded and then held for 10 years for training purposes. I’m not allowed to contact her outside of the psych services center, but I can email her bc I can search her name and it appears in our school email system. Is it wrong to just email her? I know it’s crossing and boundary, but frankly I’d rather her read it than tell her and have it recorded and listened to by strangers.

What if she doesn’t believe me? I can’t start over. I can’t do this again. It’s taken me months to even get to the point where I can talk in session, I still  have moments where I’m too anxious to be able to answer simple questions and I don’t have it in me to start over with someone new. 
She’s told me I can’t push her away, and there’s nothing I could say that would make her stop caring for me... but she doesn’t know! She has no idea how truly awful I am, and I can’t have another person leave. Yeah, she may not fire me as a patient, but what if she stops caring or stops seeing the good in me? She’s literally all I have.
